body:
Today, we’re introducing Devin Bots : engineering teammates that own your goals and lead teams of Devins to deliver them.

A coding agent can finish every task you give it while still leaving you responsible for moving the project forward. Someone has to identify the next problem, investigate possible solutions, and check whether the changes actually helped.

We built Devin Bots to take on more of that responsibility. A Bot is a persistent agent with its own memory and tools that can lead multiple Devins in parallel. You can give it a large project or an ongoing goal. It investigates, delegates work, and evaluates the results to decide what to pursue next. It retains context across sessions and brings you only the decisions that need your judgment.

You can ask a Devin Bot to maintain your open-source repo, keep Android at parity with iOS, manage your releases, or optimize server inference. A Devin Bot can own an outcome end-to-end.

Devin Bots has tripled my productivity overnight. I’m very impressed so far.
